breadcrumb.resourceSwitcherBody: Pass same-level resources to the final breadcrumb item to let people switch context without leaving the path. Hover the current resource to open its menu.
breadcrumb.b1: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.
breadcrumb.b2: Additional classes applied to the nav element.
breadcrumb.l0: Destination when the default anchor element is used.
breadcrumb.l1: Composes breadcrumb behavior onto a router link or custom anchor.
breadcrumb.p0: Responsive wrapping list that controls path spacing and typography.
breadcrumb.p1: Groups one link, page label, or ellipsis item.
breadcrumb.p2: Current page label with aria-current=page and an optional 20px icon.
breadcrumb.p4: Presentation-only marker for collapsed path levels.
